title: Evening check-in asks 'anything you need before bed?' and then keeps talking
method: composed a real evening check-in and read the message order
triggers: any evening check-in with at least one enrichment
observed_at_discovery: compose_evening uses generate_evening_summary() as the greeting, and that summary ends with the closing question. all_messages then appends everything else after it. Observed: "Good evening, Robert. It's time for your Amlodipine. Is there anything you need before bed?" followed by three further lines (hydration, dinner, a bathroom grab-bar question). A live 'cura rehearse' produced the same shape with four trailing lines including a scam warning. The change under review moved the evening medication line into that same blob, pushing the closer further from the end. pytest exit 1, 1 failed.
